preview: Discussed nutrition goals, exercise routine, and stress management strategies.

transcript.rawText:
Coach: Good afternoon, Jane. How have you been feeling this week?

Client: Hi! I've been doing pretty well. I've been trying to eat healthier and exercise more.

Coach: That's great to hear. Can you tell me more about your nutrition goals?

Client: Sure. I want to eat more vegetables and cut down on processed foods. I've been meal prepping on Sundays.

Coach: Excellent strategy. How about your exercise routine?

Client: I've started walking 30 minutes every morning before work. It really helps me feel more energized.

Coach: That's wonderful progress. How are you managing stress?

Client: I've been practicing meditation for 10 minutes each evening. It helps me wind down before bed.
